blocks.body:
name = "acme/judges-typos"
version = "1.0.0"
[verifier.judges.agent]
model = "m"
budgett = { tokens = "2M" }
timout = "10m"
reasoning = false

[verifier.judges.llm]
harness = "claude-code@2"
budget = { tool_calls = 5 }
min_samples = 3
samples = 2

diagnostics.message: [verifier.judges.llm] harness is for the agent role only: an llm judge is one model call with the evidence inline
[verifier.judges.llm] budget tool_calls is for the agent role only: an llm judge makes one call and uses no tools

unknown key 'budgett' in [verifier.judges.agent]; did you mean budget? it holds aggregate, brief, budget, effort, harness, min_samples, model, per, resources, samples, services, timeout, views, or x- extensions

unknown key 'timout' in [verifier.judges.agent]; did you mean timeout? it holds aggregate, brief, budget, effort, harness, min_samples, model, per, resources, samples, services, timeout, views, or x- extensions
[verifier.judges.agent] reasoning is gone: the evidence items trajectory and trajectory:reasoning say, criterion by criterion, whether a judge reads the solver's reasoning
the agent judge has no token budget ([verifier.judges.agent] budget = { tokens = ... }): here it is bounded by its timeout, 20m, but purpose = "rl" and delivery grade require one
